scientific_integrity: The proof uses compact spectral theory, a rank-codimension intersection, and the singular-value min-max principle. The attached numerical checker is supplementary only. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The operator must be invertible and its modulus must differ compactly from a positive scalar identity.
The level-budget theorem counts all singular values strictly below the scalar essential level; it does not classify operators with other essential spectra.
The source-specific novelty comparison is best knowledge, not an independent publication-priority determination.
title: Sharp Schatten repair tails for essentially scalar moduli
